What We Offer

At Convverge, we build business-level applications on Microsoft Azure, SharePoint, and the Power Platform that solve complex, high-stakes problems for our clients. We're regional leaders in a growing cloud technology space — and we're growing with it. You'll work alongside developers, architects, and designers who take quality seriously, on projects that challenge you to think beyond the task in front of you.


About Our Team

We’re a close-knit, high-trust team that moves quickly, supports one another, and takes pride in delivering quality work. We lead with quality as a design principle, not an afterthought.


We work in small, empowered teams where junior developers are given meaningful opportunities to contribute, ask questions, learn from experienced team members, and build confidence through real project work.


We value diverse backgrounds and experiences because the best solutions come from teams that don’t all think the same way.


About You

We are seeking a Junior Software Developer who is curious, motivated, and excited to grow in a collaborative technical environment. You enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and turning business requirements into practical software solutions. You may be early in your career, but you bring strong fundamentals, a willingness to ask thoughtful questions, and a commitment to building reliable, high-quality work.


Key Responsibilities

    Contribute to the design, development, testing, and support of client solutions in collaboration with senior developers and project teams.
    Work within an Agile development environment, following team processes, coding standards, and delivery best practices.
    Break down problems into smaller tasks and seek guidance when needed to prioritize and move work forward.
    Create and maintain as-built documentation for client solutions.
    Build and update technical support documentation for internal teams and client solutions.
    Support testing and quality assurance activities by reviewing functionality, documenting issues, and helping validate fixes.
    Develop software components and solutions using Microsoft technologies, including the Power Platform, with support from experienced team members.
    Communicate questions, blockers, risks, or delays early so the team can support successful project delivery.


Qualifications and Experience

    Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Development, Information Technology, or a related program, or equivalent practical experience.
    Approximately 0–2 years of software development experience, including internships, co-op placements, academic projects, personal projects, or professional experience.
    Foundational experience with at least one programming language, such as C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or a similar language.
    Basic familiarity with version control tools such as Git.
    Interest in Microsoft cloud technologies, including Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint.
    Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
    Clear verbal and written communication skills, with a willingness to ask questions and share progress openly.


Nice to Have

    Exposure to Agile development practices through work, school, or project experience.
    Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or Power Platform.
    Experience with C#, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, databases, or web development frameworks.
    Previous experience working on client-facing, consulting, or team-based software projects.


Benefits

    Competitive salary and benefits package.
    Opportunity to learn from experienced developers, consultants, architects, and project teams.
    Career advancement, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
    Hands-on exposure to Microsoft cloud technologies and meaningful client projects.


What We Expect

Our team shows up ready to do great work, and we expect the same from you. We collaborate, take ownership seriously, ask for help when needed, and hold each other to a high standard. In return, you’ll find a team that supports your growth and clients who genuinely value what we build together.


What We Value

Our company leads with a values-based mindset, and we believe the best career matches happen when personal values align with ours. Before you apply, take a moment to review our five core values — we think it's worth your time.

About AlayaCare

At AlayaCare, we are more than just a fast-growing SaaS company — we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.

With 650+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we’re united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.

About the Role

As a Junior Fullstack Developer (Python), you will work closely with experienced developers and product team members to contribute to real product features. You will contribute to meaningful projects while learning modern development practices, tools, and workflows. You will be supported by mentors who will help you develop both your technical abilities and professional skills.

What You’ll Do

- Assist in designing, coding, testing, and debugging software features.
- Use GenAI tools to help plan, generate, and test code.
- Pair-program with senior developers and participate in code reviews to learn best practices.
- Write and maintain automated tests with guidance from team members.
- Help investigate, reproduce, and resolve bugs under supervision.
- Participate in team rituals such as standups, demos, and retrospectives.
- Learn and apply modern development practices, including Implementing with AI, CI/CD, containerization, and monitoring.

What You Bring to the Team

- Familiarity with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, or similar).
- Demonstrated interest in AI tools, with a proactive mindset toward integrating them into day-to-day work to drive efficiency and innovation.
- Interest in learning development tools and workflows such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
- Curiosity about current industry trends in technology, performance, and software development practices.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical teammates.
- Interest in developing yourself as a full stack developer as you’ll implement in both Front-End and Back-End code.
- Bilingual in French and English is considered an asset.

Why Join AlayaCare?

Work With Purpose

At AlayaCare, you’ll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.

Grow in a High-Trust Culture

We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you’ll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote-from-within philosophy.

Inclusive by Design

We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee-led events, summits, and social activities — both in-person and virtual — create meaningful connections across our global teams.

Location and Work Model

This role is based in the Greater Montreal Area. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes set in-office collaboration days, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.

Ready to Join Us?

Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.

AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically, you may request a human review.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to careers@alayacare.com.

About Us:

Founded in 1994, Blue Falls Manufacturing (BFM) is the proud producer of Arctic Spas® Hot Tubs and All Weather Pools. We are proud to be Canada’s largest hot tub dealer, providing the best product and service in the industry. BFM thrives on inspiration, innovative engineering, and employee dedication and experience. Our team is customer focused, delivering the highest level of service and product quality possible.

Summary

Arctic Spas / Blue Falls Manufacturing is building an internal AI and automation capability that connects our CRM, point-of-sale, e-commerce, and business intelligence systems across four brands, 200+ dealers, and approximately 14 corporate stores. This work currently runs as a one-person department, and we are adding a Junior Developer to scale delivery.

This is a hands-on, build-focused role for an early-career developer who wants to work across the full stack of modern business automation: APIs, data pipelines, AI/LLM integrations, and internal tools. You will work directly alongside the Head of Business Analytics & AI Strategy, with broad exposure to production systems from day one and a clear path to grow into a full-stack automation engineer.

About the Role

Finofo is looking for an exceptional early-career frontend engineer. You might be graduating this year, recently graduated, or already have some professional experience.

We care much less about years on your resume than we do about aptitude, learning velocity, technical judgment, and curiosity.


The people we are looking for usually have one thing in common: They were building things before anyone paid them to.


You have probably:

• Built personal projects outside of school or work

• Gone deep on technical problems because you were curious

• Shipped an app, website, tool, extension, game, automation, or something else you wanted to exist

• Spent time improving an interface even when nobody asked you to

• Developed a genuine interest in frontend engineering beyond treating it as a job category

Now you want to apply that energy to a meaningful product with real customers, real complexity, and significantly more ownership than most companies give engineers this early in their careers.


About Finofo

Finofo is building an AI-native platform for how businesses control, understand, and execute spend.

Finance teams still manage purchasing, approvals, invoices, payments, reconciliation, and other critical workflows across disconnected systems and manual processes.


Finofo is building one intelligent operating layer that helps automate that work from:

• Approval

• Purchasing

• Invoicing

• Payment

• Reconciliation


Finofo is backed by Desjardins and leading US venture investors, with an established product, a growing customer base, and increasing adoption among mid-market finance teams.


The Role

This is an early-career role but it is not a low-ownership role.

You will:

• Build real parts of the Finofo product used by real customers

• Work closely with experienced engineers, designers, and founders

• Take ideas from early concepts through implementation and production

• Make product and technical decisions instead of only implementing tickets

• Learn how to turn complex workflows into fast, polished interfaces

• Take on larger problems as quickly as your capability allows


Sometimes you will start with a polished design.

Other times you might start with:

• A rough prototype

• A customer problem

• A product requirement

• A conversation with another engineer

• An incomplete workflow that still needs to be figured out


We expect you to develop the judgment to fill in what is missing.

That means thinking through questions like:

• What should happen after the user takes this action?

• What happens while data is loading?

• What happens when something fails?

• What changes based on role or permission?

• What should happen when AI is uncertain?

• Can this interaction be simpler?

• Does the implementation actually feel as good as the design intended?


What You’ll Work On

You will build product experiences across areas such as:

• Purchase requests and approvals

• Purchase orders

• Invoice capture and processing

• AI-assisted coding and classification

• Matching and exception handling

• Vendor management

• Payments

• Expenses

• Reconciliation

• Spend visibility and controls


This is complex B2B software with dense data, permissions, financial workflows, exceptions, AI recommendations, and many different product states.

Making that complexity feel simple is a difficult frontend engineering problem. That is what makes the work interesting.


Why This Role Is Different

At many larger companies, responsibility follows a fairly predetermined timeline.

At Finofo, responsibility follows capability.


If you demonstrate that you can:

• Understand difficult problems

• Make good technical decisions

• Ship high-quality work

• Learn quickly

• Take ownership

…we will keep giving you bigger problems.


You will have experienced people around you to learn from, but you will not need to wait several years before contributing to important parts of the product.

For the right person, this creates a much steeper learning curve than a traditional new-grad role.


We Care About What You Build

Your resume matters.

The things you chose to build when nobody required you to build them matter more.

We would love to see:

• Personal projects

• Products you have shipped

• Open-source contributions

• Hackathon projects

• Developer tools

• Websites or apps you obsessed over

• Technical experiments

• Something weird you built because you wanted to understand how it worked

The project does not need thousands of users.


We care about:

• Why you built it

• How deeply you went

• The decisions you made

• The problems you ran into

• What you learned

• What you would do differently now

A small project with real technical depth is more interesting to us than a long list of technologies on a resume.


AI-Native Engineering

AI is already changing how software gets built.

We use Claude and Codex heavily and expect you to become extremely effective with them.

That means using AI to:

• Move quickly from idea to implementation

• Explore unfamiliar parts of a codebase

• Generate and compare implementation approaches

• Debug problems

• Refactor generated code

• Prototype ideas rapidly

• Learn unfamiliar technologies faster


But using AI well does not mean accepting whatever it generates.

You still need to:

• Understand the code

• Recognize bad abstractions

• Catch incorrect assumptions

• Make good technical decisions

• Care about maintainability

• Develop your own engineering judgment

The distance between an idea and working software is collapsing.

We want engineers who are excited about what that makes possible.


What We’re Looking For

You are likely a strong fit if:

• You are a new grad or early in your engineering career

• You have built software outside required school or work assignments

• You are genuinely interested in frontend engineering

• You have strong JavaScript, HTML, and CSS fundamentals

• You have experience with React

• You care about interaction quality, responsiveness, and visual polish

• You are interested in how the product works, not only how the code works

• You learn new technologies quickly

• You use AI development tools heavily or want to become excellent at using them

• You are comfortable reading unfamiliar code and figuring things out

• You ask good questions

• You have high standards for your own work

• You are energized by ambitious people moving quickly

We do not use years of post-graduation experience as a proxy for capability.


This Role Is Probably Not For You If

• Most of what you have built exists because a course or employer required it

• You see frontend mainly as translating Figma files into code

• You want every implementation decision specified before you begin

• You avoid unfamiliar technical problems

• You are uncomfortable using AI development tools

• You want narrowly defined responsibilities

• You prefer an environment where scope expands primarily with tenure

There are good engineering roles structured that way.

This is not one of them.


How We Work

Finofo is a small, ambitious team based in downtown Calgary. We work together in person.


You will get:

• Short feedback loops

• Direct access to founders, engineering, product, and design

• Real ownership early

• Experienced teammates to learn from

• The ability to turn good ideas into shipped product quickly

• Exposure to product decisions beyond your immediate code


We value people who:

• Think independently

• Learn unusually quickly

• Ask good questions

• Build things

• Move with urgency

• Care about details

• Use new tools aggressively

• Want to understand the entire product


Our Stack

• React

• shadcn/ui

• Claude

• Codex

• Linear

The tools will change over time. Your ability to learn matters more than whether you already know every technology we use.


Interview Process

1. Online Development Challenge

You will complete a practical frontend engineering challenge.

• AI tools are permitted

• Use the workflow and tools you would actually use

• We care about the quality of the result and the decisions behind it

• We are not testing whether you can memorize syntax without assistance


2. Live Engineering Working Session

We will work through a realistic engineering problem together.

We want to see:

• How you break down an unfamiliar problem

• What questions you ask

• How you explore a codebase

• How you make implementation decisions

• How you use AI

• How you debug

• How quickly you turn an idea into something tangible


3. Final Interview

A final conversation with members of the founding and engineering team about:

• How you think

• How you work with others

• What you want to learn

• The kind of responsibility you want

• What you want to build next


What You Get

• Competitive base salary

• Meaningful equity

• Significant ownership early in your career

• An accelerated path to larger technical and product responsibilities

• Experienced engineers and teammates to learn from

• Direct access to founders, product, and design

• An established product with real customers

• Relocation support where applicable

• Downtown Calgary office with gym access, coffee, snacks, and games


You do not need to wait five years before working on important problems. If you demonstrate that you are ready for more responsibility, we will give it to you.


We are looking for someone near the beginning of their career who has already shown that building software is something they would be doing whether or not it was their job.

If that is you, show us what you have built.
